name: Cape of the Swashbuckler
body:
Aura faint transmutation and universal; CL 10th; Slot shoulders; Price 6,500 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This stylish piece of clothing never seems to tatter, nor do the colors fade.

Benefit: The wearer of this cape gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC and a +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, prestidigitation, eagle’s splendor, haste; Cost 3,250 gp
